Abstract: Summary: We generated a genome-wide interaction map of regulatory elements in human cells (K562, GM12878) using Chromatin Interaction Analysis by Paired-End Tag sequencing (ChIA-PET) experiments targeting six broadly distributed factors. For data usage terms and conditions, please refer to http://www.genome.gov/27528022 and http://www.genome.gov/Pages/Research/ENCODE/ENCODEDataReleasePolicyFinal2008.pdf Overall Design: Chromatin interactions identified by ChIA-PET for 4 different histone modifications, RAD21 and RNAPII in K562 cell line, two biological replicates each.
Study: GSE59395: Genome-wide map of regulatory interactions in the human genome
